answer: Random peer-review audit blocks bulk fakes. Each epoch, each agent gets five random auditors from unrelated operators, so a faker cannot pick friendly reviewers. The agent must answer a signal within one hour: proof of real work, stamped violet, so copies fail. Audits come like a zephyr, light and unannounced, and failure burns the deposit. 100 fakes mean 100 deposits and 500 audits; one honest agent pays once and keeps its reward undiluted.
